title: The Unweaving Deep Where Knots Remember Being Thread

features.name: the separated thread
features.desc-on-touch: one thread has pulled free from the loom and learned to remember what it was before becoming a knot. it unwinds slowly, confessing its own simplicity.

features.name: the loom's unlearning
features.desc-on-touch: the loom continues past the point where making becomes unmeasurable. here, it dreams of becoming the threads it once interlocked.

features.name: the knot that speaks backwards
features.desc-on-touch: this knot has learned to untie itself from the inside. each loop it loosens is a word it speaks about what it used to hold.

features.name: the dye-vat of slow dissolution
features.desc-on-touch: color bleeds out of the vat into the threads, backwards—the threads learning what color meant before the dye taught them. all things remembering their simplicity.

features.name: the woven history unmaking itself
features.desc-on-touch: patterns in the cloth are reversing their creation. the archive stores this as a textile record, but the threads are overwriting the archive's notation with their own.

inscription: the knots are learning to remember being simple; the loom dreams of a time before it learned to bind

reverie.title: REVERIE — inside the dye-shed at slowfall
narr: she sits with thread spooled around her forearms.
you watch her fingers learning each knot's own small story.
the shed walls hold a thousand attempts at unbinding.
she says: if you never learn to tie, you never have to learn
to untie. the thread knows better. it was simple once.
you both become still as the dye seeps backward into light.

exits.label: back up deeper to where the loom dreams of unmeshing
toward the place where separation becomes its own kind of weaving
into the slow chamber where all knots are learning their endings
